notes.title: Vive Console Beta Updated - 2.1.24.9a
notes.content:
Released Jan 8, 2024

 Updated VIVE OpenXR Hand tracking/facial tracking API layers for issue fixes.

notes.title: Vive Console Beta Updated - 2.1.24.9
notes.content:
[VIVE Console]
[SR Runtime version 1.3.6.12d]

 Fixed an issue with the SRAnipal causing Vive_VBS log to grow significantly large. 
     Changes including disabling repeatedly log pattern and reduce the log size limits to 100Mb. 

[VIVE OpenXR Hand tracking API layer 1.0.0.23]

 Fixed the problem that in the unity editor mode, the second execution may encounter a crash problem.
 Block the support of hand related features on WebXR in order to address the crash on it.

[XR Tracking API layer 0.0.0.12]

 Fixed the problem that in the unity editor mode, the second execution may encounter a crash problem.
 Fixed handInteractionHTC failed to update pose when XRTracker layer is enabled.

Improve stability.
 
[Vive OpenXR Facial Tracking API layer] 0.1.8.9
Add support for “XR_HTC_eye_tracker” extension.

notes.title: Vive Console Beta Updated - 2.1.24.5
notes.content:
[VIVE Console]

 VIVE Cosmos Elite: OpenXR Runtime selection has been removed, and the suitable one will be automatically used.
 VIVE Pro 2: Tearing issue with NV 40-series GPU has been improved.

[Vive OpenXR Facial tracking] 0.1.7.1

 Corrected the eye gaze data.
 Fixed a crash issue when using UE editor mode.
 Fixed an issue where the eye gaze data would not be retrieved if both eye gaze extension and facial tracking extension were enabled.

notes.title: Vive Console Beta Updated - 2.1.24.4
notes.content:
[VIVE Console]

 A hot fix has been developed to rectify an error identified in the 2.0.24.3 release.

[Vive OpenXR] 0.1.9.9

 Correct the validation of localized name of paths.

[Vive OpenXR Hand Tracking] 1.0.0.12

 Fixed a bug which was affecting the hand interaction extension.
 Addressed an issue where hand tracking could not be started for the second time in UE editor mode.

notes.title: Vive Console Beta Updated - 2.1.24.2
notes.content:
[Vive OpenXR] 0.1.9.8

 Support XR_EXT_palm_pose for Vive Cosmos controller.
 Modify implementation of xrEnumerateInstanceExtensionProperties() based on the spec to avoid OpenXR content crash issues.
 Refined the cleanup process to prevent play failed for the 2nd time in Editor mode of Unreal.

[Vive OpenXR Hand Tracking] 1.0.0.10

 Support XR_EXT_palm_pose.
 Address an issue that when only XR_HTC_hand_interaction is requested without XR_EXT_hand_tracking, the tracking engine would not work.
 Resolved a dll unsigned issue to cause Easy Anti-cheat to block content from launching.

[Vive OpenXR Facial Tracking] 0.1.6.8

 Report the system property according to the HW capability.

[Vive OpenXR Facial Tracking] 0.1.6.8

 Bug fixes.

notes.title: Vive Console Beta Updated - 2.1.22.1
notes.content:
[Console]

 Fixed bug causing unable to use gaze point to select SteamVR menu for Cosmos Elite Headset without controllers.

[SRAnipal]

 Now supported more data formats in SRAnipal SDK which includes V1 format and separate eye data when connecting Focus 3 eye and facial tracker via Vive Business Streaming.
 Refined the timing of engine initialization.
 Enhanced error handling on eye expression.
 Now supports Eye and Facial tracking via Vive Business Streaming for Focus 3.
 Note: Eye/Facial tracking support via VBS for Focus 3 only supports content using SRAnipal V2 format, please reach out to the content providers to check for more detail.
            This support also requires replacing this dll under each content folder, sample paths are listed as followed.
            Unity: “{AppRoot}\AppName_Data\Plugins\”
            UE: “{AppRoot}\Plugins\SRanipal\Binaries\Win64\”

[VIVE OpenXR]

 Fixed a potential memory leakage when swapchain is being repeatedly created and destroyed.
 Fixed an issue feedback from forum to report correct texture format of depth texture when using OpenGL graphic plugin. (Link)
 Cleaned up and disabled unnecessary API layers to prevent OpenXR initialization error.
